measures.rss: Memory the process was holding when the scenario's work was done, in bytes: after the first screen and before closing for a new pod, after the first answer and before closing for a pod given a document again, after the second read for a reopened one, after a first read and before the pages for the question pages.
measures.peak-rss: The most memory the process held at any moment, in bytes.
measures.probed-total: The scenario's time in one run with the probe on, which slows some work; its stages are from this run and are for finding where time goes, never for adding up to the headline.
